payload.summary: Nothing schedules a bundle-budget baseline refresh, so accumulated growth fails whichever unrelated PR lands last
payload.detail: The production baseline sat at ca788d41 (2026-08-13) untouched while main grew +8.03% by 2026-08-18, leaving ~2 points of headroom. PR #2096 (Dictionary) then failed Build at +10.5% for 2.7 points of its own weight. Re-baselined once in docs/evidence/bundle-budget-production-rebaseline-2026-08-18.md, but the same squeeze recurs unless a refresh has an owner or a trigger: options are a scheduled job that re-measures and opens a PR, a drift warning threshold below the failure threshold, or recording the baseline commit distance in the check output so staleness is visible before it blocks someone.
